Which one you use is the single biggest decision you make about how far it goes. The two drive modes of the KG05 and the range each returns One starting point splitting into two paths: pure electric on the throttle returning twenty-two miles, and pedal assist returning thirty-seven miles. START 22 miles PURE ELECTRIC 37 miles PEDAL ASSIST Pure electric is the moped-style way to ride it: twist and go, feet on the pegs, 22 miles. It is the mode most people use most of the time, and 20 mph is the default top speed. Pedal assist adds your own effort to the motor’s and takes the same battery fifteen miles further . Nothing else you can do to an electric bike buys that much range. 20 mph default · 37 mi assisted · 1000W peak · 85 N·m · 330 lb load 20 × 4.0″ KENDA What the NAVEE KG05 electric bike rides on The tires are KENDA 20 by 4.0-inch fat tires. Four inches of tire at low pressure is an air spring in its own right, which is why a fat tire electric bike feels composed on surfaces that would unsettle a narrow one — gravel paths, sand, packed snow, broken city asphalt. Behind them is a front fork with rear dual suspension , so both wheels are sprung as well. Braking is dual hydraulic disc . On a machine rated to carry 330 lbs , hydraulic actuation is what keeps the lever feel consistent whether you are riding solo or loaded. NAVEE rates climbing at 10 to 15 degrees . Tires KENDA 20″ × 4.0″ Suspension Front fork + rear dual Brakes Dual hydraulic disc Max load 330 lbs Climbing 10–15° A moped-style frame with pedals, on four-inch tires.
